Country.evidence_source: In this study we explored the role of alcohol in suicide in postconflict Northern Uganda.

Population.evidence_source: In this study we explored the role of alcohol in suicide in postconflict Northern Uganda. The findings indicated that alcohol acted as a facilitator of suicidal acts, was used as a means to implement the act, or had an influence on the overall lifestyle of some of the decedents who abused alcohol. It further influenced the suicidal process of significant others as victims of those who misuse alcohol.
